summary: In this Goodful episode, a host and guest explore vegan desserts by sampling store-bought vegan ice creams (including Salt & Straw lavender honey) and a studio-made vegan ice cream, then visit an all-vegan bakery to search for a chocolate-chip cookie that can stand up to traditional versions. They discuss vegan ice cream base formulations (oatmeal and coconut milk), fats (coconut oil), sweeteners, acids, and the use of add-ins and sauces. Back in the studio, they attempt a vegan chocolate chip cookie using egg-free substitutes (fruit purées), arrowroot, and garbanzo bean flour, prioritizing crispy edges and chewy centers. The episode closes with a tasting ranking, a comparison to non-vegan benchmarks (e.g., Lavender Honey from Salt & Straw), and a home-friendly recipe so viewers can recreate the results without traveling to vegan hubs.
